title: Draped Green & Red Scene
desc: Cream draped backdrop with wine ribbon bows, dressed by a lush green column and deep red blooms.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: Deep red blooms scattered through the green column and along the base.

items.role: Deep red roses dotted through the greenery column and base line (dark red Austin tone, closest to the wine-red single heads in the scene).
Dark red ranunculus layered between the roses for rounded depth.

groups.label: Green ball filler
groups.blurb: The round green face breaking up the red-and-green scheme.

items.role: Light green hydrangea ball adding a rounded green face to the planting (scene uses a true green ball; this is the closest green hydrangea in the library).

groups.label: Foliage & grasses
groups.blurb: The feathery, trailing greens that build the whole left column.

items.role: Feathery asparagus fern forming the main airy texture across the column.
Long fine grass tails cascading down the centre of the green column (form-match trailing grass).
Eucalyptus sprigs adding flat oval leaves through the middle layer.
Dark green pine spray giving fine needle texture at the edges.

groups.label: Drapery
groups.blurb: The cream backdrop that carries the wine-red ribbon bows.

items.role: Cream milk-silk draped backdrop with gathered swags, finished with wine-red ribbon bows (bows are a logged gap).
